column1: # Named lists of organisms a reader looks a eukaryote reference up by (benchmarks/eukore_bench/resource.py; since
# 2026-11-12): each entry is found in NCBI's taxonomy by its name (a scientific name or a synonym; a species, or a
# genus or higher taxon: then every species of it counts), and panels.tsv of the results says what the package holds of
# it. Columns: panel, name, an NCBI taxid (only where the name does not find the taxon: resource.py warns), a note.
# The lists are a starting point, to be edited: add a line, or a panel.
# - WHO fungal priority pathogens: WHO fungal priority pathogens list to guide research, development and public health
#   action (2022), its 19 entries; the note is WHO's priority group.
# - human parasites: a selection of the protozoa and helminths of CDC's DPDx and WHO's neglected tropical diseases.
# - model organisms: the eukaryote model organisms of genetics, cell and evolutionary biology.
# - mock communities: the eukaryotes of ZymoBIOMICS' microbial community standards (D6300, D6331) and ATCC's mycobiome

column4: high (NCBI: Lodderomyces parapsilosis, its synonym with its authors)
